findings_qualitative.value: AT2018cow lies between a CO peak and a blue young cluster, indicating ongoing star formation

evidence.quote: AT2018cow is located between one of the CO peaks and a blue stellar cluster

claims.hypothesis: Is CGCG 137-068 a normal star-forming dwarf in molecular gas properties?
claims.experiment: Compare Mmol, SFE and gas ratios with xGASS/xCOLD-GASS
claims.result: Normal in SFR, Matom/Mstar, Mmol/Mstar, SFE(mol), Mmol/Matom; high metallicity for its mass
claims.finding: Normal SF dwarf galaxy except high metallicity

evidence.quote: CGCG 137-068 is a normal SF dwarf galaxy in terms of SFR

claims.hypothesis: Does the AT2018cow site favor a massive-star progenitor over a TDE?
claims.experiment: Compare site N(H2), location and host properties with CCSN and TDE samples
claims.result: N(H2)=8.6e20 cm^-2 comparable to Type-I CCSNe; near CO peak and young cluster
claims.finding: Massive-star explosion favored, especially SNe Ic-BL without GRB

evidence.quote: both the host-galaxy and local-site properties of the AT2018cow are indicative of massive-star explosions

why_this_data.value: Archival ToO data covered CO(1-0) though intended for continuum

evidence.quote: Since the original purpose of this observation is to measure the continuum flux of AT2018cow at band 3

limitations_admitted.value: FELT host metallicity sample is too small to conclude
